title: Divine Perfection: Maximal Coherence as Perfection

canonical_node.axiom: God is maximally coherent; maximal coherence is perfection; maximal coherence is unique.
definitions: Perfection: state of maximal coherence, C[chi] = C_max, with no contradiction, no defect, no room for improvement.
Maximal coherence (C_max): complete internal consistency, zero contradiction, infinite integration (Phi = ).
Coherence (C[chi]): objectively measurable property of a system; higher coherence means less contradiction.
God: the unique entity with C = C_max.
derivation: Perfection is not arbitrary but mathematically defined as C[chi] = C_max.
God has maximal coherence: C[chi_God] = C_max.
Maximal coherence is perfection: Perfection  C_max.
Maximal coherence is unique: X,Y: (C[X]=C_max  C[Y]=C_max) -> X=Y.
Therefore, God is the unique perfect being.
canonical_node.action: The system should treat perfection as maximal coherence, use coherence as an objective measure, and recognize God as the unique maximally coherent being.
boundary: Does not claim that finite beings can achieve C_max.
Does not define the specific mathematical form of C[chi] beyond reference to F03.
Does not address the existence of God; assumes it from prior axioms.
test: Check that any entity with C = C_max is unique.
Verify that all traditional perfection attributes map to coherence.
Ensure that no finite being is assigned C = C_max.

dg_protocol.dg2_new_capability: Provides a formal, objective definition of perfection as maximal coherence, enabling mathematical treatment of divine attributes.
dg_protocol.dg3_preserved_floor: Preserves the concept of God's uniqueness and absolute perfection, consistent with classical theism.
dg_protocol.dg4_collapse_if_removed: Without this axiom, perfection becomes subjective or relative, undermining the objective grounding of moral and metaphysical truths.

classification.recommended_atom_action: formalize as axiom with dependency on F03; require explicit proof of uniqueness and measurability

overstatement_risks: Claims coherence is objectively measurable without providing full formal definition in this document.
Assumes uniqueness of maxima without rigorous proof in the document.
Maps physical concepts (ground state, symmetry) to perfection without justification.
kill_conditions: If coherence is not objectively measurable, the axiom fails.
If multiple maxima can exist, uniqueness fails.
If perfection is not equivalent to maximal coherence, the definition is arbitrary.
risk.lean_target: Formalize C[chi] and prove uniqueness of C_max in a formal system.

plain_summary: This document defines God's perfection as maximal coherence, arguing that perfection is objective and unique. It prosecutes moral relativism, imperfect God theories, and finite perfectionism. The argument relies on the measurability of coherence and the uniqueness of maxima, but these are not fully formalized here.
